scope: Devtools pictures use running WebHost code with deliberately supplied status changes, not a full jet dev compiler/reload run. Learn pictures show the recorded executable in a real terminal. Its question/help/pause/resume wording is current; the final watcher and failed-check message edits are not in that executable. The full rebuild and complete lesson execution remain unproved.

media.alt: Red Jet logo inside a rounded-square green status ring.
media.caption: Running WebHost code, the server Jet uses for browser apps. The small button is square with rounded corners; green means ready.

media.alt: The Jet button expands into the compact Lens view.
media.caption: Lens is the compact details view. The Jet logo stays visible, and panels sit inside three groups rather than one long row of buttons.

media.alt: The full Devtools view has a Jet logo and grouped build and source panels.
media.caption: Workbench is the larger inspection view. This is its own browser page, with the Jet logo still visible.

media.alt: Data and request panels nested under one expandable group.
media.caption: Open Data & requests to reach routes, queries, mutations, forms, tables, stores, and databases. Other groups can stay closed.

media.alt: Runtime and interface panels nested under one expandable group.
media.caption: Open Runtime & interface to reach traces, cost, UI tree, topology, game, world, and profiler panels.

media.alt: The expanded Devtools view fits a phone-width screen.
media.caption: Phone-width view. The logo and group headings remain visible; the page does not need sideways scrolling.

media.alt: The Jet logo remains visible inside an amber dashed ring.
media.caption: The check program put the real server into its building state. The ring turns amber and dashed; reduced-motion settings stop its animation. This is not proof of a completed build.

media.alt: A red status ring and readable E0003 message on a narrow screen.
media.caption: A real compiler error is shown by the running server. Long lines wrap, source text is not treated as page markup, and the last working page remains behind the message.

media.alt: The Jet control returns to a green ready ring after an error.
media.caption: The check program returned the server to ready. The error message and page shading cleared, and the ring became green again.

media.alt: The Jet logo remains visible inside a gray dotted ring.
media.caption: The check program put the server into reconnecting state. The ring becomes gray and dotted, so the cue does not depend on color alone.

media.alt: Colored lesson headings, source code, one question, and a highlighted current step.
media.caption: The code appears above the question. The prompt now says unknown, which opens the written explanation.

media.alt: Typing unknown opens the written explanation and returns to the question.
media.caption: Unknown shows the lesson explanation immediately. It does not count as a correct prediction or complete the lesson.

media.alt: A yellow PAUSED message confirms that the incomplete lesson was saved.
media.caption: Cancel at the learn> prompt saves the current step and returns to the shell. The saved record still marks the lesson incomplete.

media.alt: Reopening Learn returns to the same source file and question.
media.caption: The same lesson resumes without losing its source or claiming that a lesson stage was completed.

supplementalMedia.caption: The authored answer matches, then real execution hits RUNTIME_HOST_FAULT. This capture predates the final failed-check and watcher wording repairs.
In an isolated package, correct is classified as incorrect and no lesson stage completes. The run hits RUNTIME_HOST_FAULT. This capture predates the final failed-check wording repair.
